title: Saudi Arabian Stew
description: A hearty, comforting stew originating from Saudi Arabia, made with exotic spices and earthy ingredients.

ingredients.name: Arabian Spices
ingredients.notes: mix of cumin, coriander, and cinnamon

instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the sautéed onions and cook until they're translucent.
Add the earthy carrots and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the Saudi Arabian split peas, Arabian spices, exotic cinnamon, salt, and black pepper.
Add 2 cups of water to the pot and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes or until the peas are tender.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
